name: BlogSprint Automatic Blogging
author: BlogSprint

sections.description:
BlogSprint Automatic Blogging is a tool for keeping your store’s blog active and growing without writing content manually.

Here’s the problem most WooCommerce store owners face: they know a good blog drives organic traffic and improves SEO, but writing consistent, high-quality blog content takes hours every week. Most store owners simply don’t have time for it, so their blog sits empty and their organic search presence never grows.

BlogSprint is designed to address this. It reads your live WooCommerce product catalog — your actual products, descriptions, and categories — and uses that information to write SEO-optimized blog posts that feature your products naturally. Then it publishes them automatically on a schedule you choose.

How it works:

  1. Connect your BlogSprint account (free, takes 30 seconds)
  2. Choose a product or category to write about, or let Autopilot handle it automatically
  3. BlogSprint writes a complete, SEO-optimized blog post in about 20 seconds
  4. Review it, publish it, or let Autopilot publish it automatically for you

How BlogSprint uses your product catalog:

Unlike generic AI writing tools, BlogSprint reads your actual WooCommerce catalog. Every post it writes mentions your real products, links to your actual product pages, and is written to target keywords relevant to your store.

Key features:

  • Reads your live WooCommerce product catalog automatically
  • Writes complete blog posts with proper SEO structure (H2/H3 headings, meta title, meta description, focus keyword)
  • Works with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and AIOSEO — automatically writes the correct SEO meta fields for whichever plugin you use
  • Autopilot mode: set a schedule (daily, twice daily, 3x daily, twice weekly, or weekly) and BlogSprint publishes posts automatically
  • Every generated post is automatically saved as a draft so you never lose a generation
  • Clean, simple admin interface designed for non-technical store owners
  • Choose your writing style: Professional, Friendly, Conversational, or Expert
  • WooCommerce HPOS compatible
  • WordPress Block Editor compatible

Free plan includes:

  • 3 AI-generated blog posts per month
  • All SEO integrations (Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO)
  • No credit card required

Upgrade for more:

  • Starter ($19/month): 20 posts/month, Autopilot scheduling, auto-publish
  • Professional ($49/month): 100 posts/month, connect up to 3 stores
  • Agency ($99/month): 500 posts/month, unlimited stores

External service disclosure:

This plugin connects to the BlogSprint service (blogsprint.io) to generate blog post content. When you generate a post, your WooCommerce product data (product names, descriptions, categories, and attributes) is sent to our servers hosted on Railway (railway.app) for AI processing.

Depending on your plan, our servers use either OpenAI’s API (openai.com) or Anthropic’s API (anthropic.com) to generate the blog post content. These services process your product data to write the post. No personally identifiable customer information is ever sent — only your product catalog data.

By using this plugin, you agree to:

  • BlogSprint Terms of Service: https://blogsprint.io/terms
  • BlogSprint Privacy Policy: https://blogsprint.io/privacy
  • OpenAI Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
  • Anthropic Terms of Service: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms
  • Railway Terms of Service: https://railway.app/legal/terms
sections.installation:
1. Upload the blogsprint folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it directly through the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active — BlogSprint requires it.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → BlogSprint in your WordPress admin menu.
  5. Enter your email address and click Connect Account to get started. A free account is created automatically.
sections.faq:
What is BlogSprint?

BlogSprint is an AI-powered service that reads your WooCommerce product catalog and automatically writes SEO-optimized blog posts featuring your products. You can generate posts manually one at a time, or use Autopilot to have posts published automatically on a schedule.

Is it free?

Yes. The free plan includes 3 AI-generated blog posts per month with no credit card required. Paid plans start at $19/month for 20 posts.

What data is sent to your servers?

When you generate a post, we send your WooCommerce product data (names, descriptions, categories, and attributes) to our servers for AI processing. We do not send any customer data, order data, or personally identifiable information. You can read our full Privacy Policy at https://blogsprint.io/privacy.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

BlogSprint automatically detects and writes SEO meta fields for Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and AIOSEO. If none of those plugins are installed, the SEO data is stored in custom post meta that you can use however you like.

Does it work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes. BlogSprint works entirely inside the WordPress admin and generates standard WordPress blog posts — it is completely independent of your theme. Generated posts will look like any other blog post on your site.

Does it work with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes. BlogSprint is fully HPOS compatible. It does not touch order data at all — it only reads your product catalog.

Can I review posts before they go live?

Yes. Every generated post is automatically saved as a draft so you can review and edit it before publishing. You can also set Autopilot to save drafts instead of publishing immediately.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your settings and generated posts are preserved. Autopilot scheduling is paused until you reactivate the plugin. If you delete the plugin entirely, all plugin settings are removed — but your generated posts remain in WordPress as normal posts.

How do I get support?

Email us at support@blogsprint.io or visit https://blogsprint.io/support and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
